Name: NCA Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CCC-2:2024)
Description: The National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CCC-2:2024) set mandatory cybersecurity requirements for Cloud Service Tenants (CSTs) and Cloud Service Providers (CSPs). This file covers only the 15 subdomains the real CCC-2:2024 document (Annex A, Table 3) assigns to the Cloud Service Tenant (CST) — i.e. the customer of the cloud, which is the role this platform's connected OCI accounts occupy. Subdomains 2-8 (Backup and Recovery), 2-10 (Penetration Testing), 2-12 (Incident and Threat Management), 2-13 (Physical Security), 2-14 (Web Application Security), 2-16 (System Development Security), 2-17 (Storage Media Security), and all of Domain 4 (Third-Party Cybersecurity) are Cloud Service Provider (CSP) obligations only in the real document and are intentionally excluded here rather than fabricated as tenant requirements. Descriptions below are paraphrased summaries of the real control intent, not verbatim reproductions of NCA's published text.

Requirements.Name: 1-1-T-1 Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities
Requirements.Description: Document and approve cloud-specific cybersecurity roles and a RACI assignment for every stakeholder involved in the tenant's cloud services, extending the entity's existing ECC 1-4-1 governance structure.

Requirements.Name: 1-2-T-1 Cybersecurity Risk Management
Requirements.Description: Define acceptable cloud risk levels, factor the tenant's own data classification into the cybersecurity risk management methodology, and maintain a cloud-specific risk register reviewed periodically.

Requirements.Name: 1-3-T-1 Compliance with Cybersecurity Standards, Laws and Regulations
Requirements.Description: Continuously monitor the cloud service provider's compliance with relevant national cybersecurity legislation and the cybersecurity clauses of the service contract.

Attributes.SubSection: 1-3 Compliance with Cybersecurity Standards, Laws and Regulations

Requirements.Name: 1-4-T-1 Cybersecurity in Human Resources
Requirements.Description: Screen or vet personnel prior to granting them access to sensitive cloud functions such as key management, service administration, or access control.

Requirements.Name: 2-1-T-1 Asset Management
Requirements.Description: Maintain an inventory of every cloud service and every information/technology asset connected to those cloud services.

Requirements.Name: 2-2-T-1 Identity and Access Management
Requirements.Description: Manage cloud credentials across their full lifecycle, keep session handling secure (authenticity, lockout, timeout), enforce multi-factor authentication for privileged cloud users, and detect unauthorized access attempts.

Requirements.Name: 2-3-T-1 Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection
Requirements.Description: Confirm the cloud provider isolates community cloud services provided to government/CNI tenants from services provided to entities outside that scope.

Attributes.SubSection: 2-3 Information System and Information Processing Facilities Protection

Requirements.Name: 2-4-T-1 Networks Security Management
Requirements.Description: Protect the network connection channel between the tenant and the cloud service provider.

Requirements.Name: 2-5-T-1 Mobile Devices Security
Requirements.Description: Securely sanitize and dispose of end-user mobile devices that have had access to the tenant's cloud services.

Requirements.Name: 2-6-T-1 Data and Information Protection
Requirements.Description: Maintain a secure exit strategy so tenant data is securely disposed of when the cloud contract ends, and use secure channels to export or transfer data and virtual infrastructure.

Requirements.Name: 2-7-T-1 Cryptography
Requirements.Description: Use strong, standards-compliant cryptographic mechanisms (per NCA's National Cryptographic Standards) and encrypt all data transferred to or from the cloud environment.

Requirements.Name: 2-9-T-1 Vulnerabilities Management
Requirements.Description: Assess and remediate vulnerabilities in cloud services at least once every three months, and act on vulnerabilities the cloud provider notifies the tenant about.

Requirements.Name: 2-11-T-1 Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
Requirements.Description: Activate and collect login events and cybersecurity event logs on all cloud service assets, and continuously monitor every log the tenant has enabled.

Attributes.SubSection: 2-11 Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management

Requirements.Name: 2-15-T-1 Key Management
Requirements.Description: Assign clear ownership for cryptographic keys, and maintain a secure key retrieval/backup mechanism stored outside the cloud environment.

Requirements.Name: 3-1-T-1 Cybersecurity Resilience Aspects of Business Continuity Management (BCM)
Requirements.Description: Develop and securely implement disaster recovery and business continuity procedures for the tenant's cloud-hosted services.

Attributes.SubSection: 3-1 Cybersecurity Resilience Aspects of Business Continuity Management (BCM)
